sources.title: PubChem
sources.snippet: PubChem is the world's largest collection of freely accessible chemical information. Search chemicals by name, molecular formula, structure, and other identifiers. Find chemical and physical properties, biological activities, safety and toxicity information, patents, literature citations and more.

sources.title: morealcholplz/ttt-vla-robomme-seqloader-preflight-r2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TTT-VLA RoboMME — SeqLoader T4 2-GPU Preflight R2 What this is A model export produced during the SeqLoader/T4 two-GPU preflight stage for RoboMME. This is a runnable intermediate/preflight artifact, not a final benchmark claim.

sources.title: morealcholplz/ttt-vla-robomme-ttt-nmt-t4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GR00T N1.6 + HAMLET + Persistent TTT — RoboMME NMT T=4 Private archival checkpoint for Nuri's persistent test-time-training experiment on RoboMME. It extends the HAMLET K=4 attention-memory policy with recurrent fast weights trained using a next-moment-token inner objective.
